title: `voids/thrownness-void` "Four independent philosophical traditions" (L52, L62) fails P-M2: Sartre, Levinas and Arendt all studied Husserl or Heidegger, and `topics/constitutive-exclusion` L63 already discounts Heidegger's thrownness as one genealogy. Also: the Sartre quotation drops "which is"; Levinas sets horror AGAINST Heideggerian anxiety (L86); Heidegger says thrownness is not a past event
